description: The Maharashtra government signed an MoU with AM Intelligence Labs for a ₹1.14 lakh crore investment to build a green data centre park and AI compute hub in Mumbai. The renewable energy-powered project aims to boost AI infrastructure and generate thousands of jobs
body_lead: Home |News |Maharashtra Signs Rs 1 14 Lakh Crore Ai Data Centre Deal Maharashtra signs Rs 1.14 Lakh Crore AI data Centre deal The Maharashtra government signed an MoU with AM Intelligence Labs for a ₹1.14 lakh crore investment to build a green data centre park and AI compute hub in Mumbai.
